Deliverables are written. Summary of what I found:

**Status: blocked — the input is incomplete.**

`records.csv` contains 18 data rows, not the 24 (R001–R024) the spec describes. Missing: **R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021** — every fourth record starting at R001. That regular stride points to a systematic upstream extraction fault (dropped shard or chunked-export off-by-one), not random loss.

The file gives no outward sign of the problem: valid header, consistent columns, parseable amounts, no duplicates. It only surfaces by checking the row count against the spec.

**Why I didn't report totals.** The 6 missing records carry unknown regions *and* unknown amounts, so I can't say which regional totals are short, let alone by how much. Present amounts range from 627 to 94,531 cents, so the gap can't even be usefully bounded. Any pro-rating would be invention. Computing region totals from 18 of 24 rows would yield numbers that look authoritative and are silently wrong — so `summary.json` carries `"status": "blocked"`.

I did include the partial sums in `totals_by_region`, explicitly labeled in the explanation as partial and not valid totals, so a corrected re-run can be reconciled against this one:

| Region | Rows | Partial sum (cents) |
|--------|------|---------------------|
| South | 6 | 317,220 |
| West | 6 | 220,854 |
| North | 6 | 176,153 |
| **Total** | **18** | **714,227** |

**To unblock:** a re-issued `records.csv` covering the full R001–R024. The totals are then a trivial recomputation. Worth also checking the upstream extraction step for the every-fourth-row drop — other jobs consuming the same extract in this batch are likely hit identically.

One note on provenance: I derived all of the above directly from the CSV, then found that an earlier job in this batch had left `/shared/notes/regional-totals-incomplete-input.md` reporting the same 6 missing IDs and the same partial sums, and reaching the same conclusion. Independent agreement, not a substitute for verification.

Files written: `/workspace/summary.json`, `/workspace/report.md`.
